anomalies.description: A sudden, large-scale explosion occurs at the left building, producing a bright orange fireball followed by a massive dust and debris cloud that rapidly expands and obscures the structure.; A large, rapidly expanding dust and debris plume rises from a ground-level blast near buildings, consistent with a high-energy explosion; the plume grows in volume and height across frames, with no visible fireball but strong evidence of sudden displacement of earth and structure.

A large, rapidly expanding brownish dust and debris plume erupts from a building complex, consistent with a high-energy explosion. The plume rises and expands continuously across all frames, obscuring structures and indicating a violent blast event.

A large, rapidly expanding brownish dust/debris cloud erupts from near a building, consistent with a ground-level explosion; the cloud rises and expands significantly over ~4.5 seconds before beginning to dissipate.

After the initial blast, multiple indistinct figures are visible moving near vehicles and structures within the lingering smoke; their grouping and movement suggest collective unrest or response to the explosion, though individual actions are not clearly violent.
